text:
Morgan (CEO): quick follow-up thread from today's all-hands Q&A about customer feedback loops  please drop concrete next steps below so we can close the loop on wins/losses.
Priya (CS): high-level themes from CS calls: compliance docs + network templates, faster onboarding for POCs, and clear SLAs around latency during peak.
Raya (Sales): adding sales color: top loss reasons were data residency reqs, lack of native connectors (particularly to legacy CRMs), and unpredictable cost for bursty traffic. A few wins cited dedicated pools + a hands-on onboarding runbook.
Liam (Solutions): two recent wins where Solutions ran a 2-week POC with dedicated capacity and a small cache layer. That reduced token spend and latency. We should capture that as a reference playbook.
Alex (Product): Proposed artifacts: 1) Compliance one-pager (what we provide vs what customer must supply), 2) Connector quickstarts (3 priority connectors), 3) POC/runbook template. I can draft the POC template. Owner: Alex. ETA: 5 business days. :memo:
Aisha (Security): I'll produce the network/KMS checklist and a short sample S3 bucket policy snippet we can share. Example snippet for customers to paste:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{ "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": "*", "Action": ["s3:GetObject"], "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::example-bucket/*"] }]
}
```
Priya (CS): Action: assemble "customer loss playbook" that includes sanitized loss notes, the compliance one-pager, and a prioritized connector list. Owner: Priya + Raya. ETA: 10 business days.
Raya (Sales): I'll upload anonymized loss notes to #sales-docs and link them here when done. Will include win patterns too.
ci-bot: Created issue #CI-3429: "closed-loop: customer feedback artifacts" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/3429)
Morgan (CEO): Good. Please add owners to the issue and tag @engineering for the connector quickstarts. Prioritize compliance one-pager and the POC runbook. We'll review this in the next leadership sync. :+1:
Priya (CS): scheduling a 30-min follow-up review next Tue 9:30am PT. Invite to go out to @here.
Liam (Solutions): I'll draft the POC checklist sections for capacity config, caching, and autoscale thresholds.
Alex (Product): Will collate inputs and post a first-pass doc to the issue. Thanks all.
